supportDecision.corpusGap: Expanded hierarchical companion coverage for the reviewed VM-20 practice-note wave. Non-binding, historical, review-only, and not promoted. Independent review and explicit promotion remain required. Substantially complete 2026 VM-01 definition coverage. Review-only and not promoted; learner, app, RAG, vector, and Copilot export remain blocked.
